mutants.description: The cycle-boundary detector is written as a generic any-edge detector, so both the rising and the falling edge of each PWM pulse count as a switching-cycle boundary.
mutants.reason: In S_SS the step window advances twice per switching cycle, so max_on_counts widens every cycles_per_step/2 cycles and SS_done arrives about twice as early. Half of the steps also land on a rising edge, so the ceiling changes mid-pulse.

mutants.description: The ceiling step is qualified by the PWM being low (the 'pulse is over' level) instead of by the one-clock falling-edge pulse.
mutants.reason: In S_SS with cycle_counter at cycles_per_step-1, max_on_counts goes up by one on every clock of the PWM low time instead of once per step window. The ramp then jumps by many counts per window, and SS_done comes far too early.

mutants.description: The return to the floor outside S_SS/S_RUN waits for a PWM falling edge, as if it were a ceiling update that must not land mid-pulse.
mutants.reason: When the supervisor leaves S_SS or S_RUN for hiccup or off, max_on_counts and SS_done keep their old values until a PWM falling edge arrives. With the stage disabled and the PWM not switching, they are never reset, so the retry re-enables at the old ceiling with SS_done already high.

mutants.description: The idle re-arm loads the step-window counter with its terminal count instead of zero, so each soft start begins at the end of a step window.
mutants.reason: On every entry to S_SS (from S_OFF and from hiccup), the first ceiling step comes at the first PWM falling edge instead of after cycles_per_step cycles. The ramp is therefore one step ahead throughout, and SS_done rises cycles_per_step-1 switching cycles early.

mutants.description: The ramp branch is entered in S_RUN as well as S_SS, so the ramp keeps running under the regulating loop instead of the ceiling being held.
mutants.reason: If the host lowers max_on_limit during S_RUN and then raises it again, max_on_counts climbs back up one count per step window while in S_RUN. The header says the ceiling must stay where the last ramp left it until the next soft start.
